name: rapha
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Rapha instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Rapha tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Rapha through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Rapha Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Rapha only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
